## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Font description members
//
// The interface obligations of the font-description types in
// `text.types.plato`. Only `FontWeight` owes one today: it is `IComparable`
// on the CSS 100-900 scale, and "bolder" is exactly "numerically greater" on
// that scale — the whole reason the scale is numeric rather than an enumeration
// of named weights.

library TextFonts
{
    // Weights order along the CSS scale: Thin (100) before Normal (400) before
    // Black (900), with the intermediate values variable fonts use ordering
    // between them.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: FontWeight, b: FontWeight): Boolean
        => a.Value <= b.Value;
}
```
